statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Cash equities closed at 20:00Z on Friday and the E-mini NQ contract settled at 21:00Z, so NQ_FUTURES and NAS100_CFD are both inside the weekend halt with no quoted price path anywhere in this 24-hour window.
recommendation: Tail sits at the low end of its band because no equity venue is open and a no-retracement path cannot form while quoting is suspended. The macro stack carried into the break - a unanimous 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00% with 16 of 18 participants projecting a further increase, a 10-year that settled 4.998% after tagging 5.008%, WTI at 100.30 dollars on a third straight decline, Bab el-Mandeb under Houthi control and a Trump-Xi summit set for 24 September - is expressed through Stress rather than Tail. Gap risk expresses at the Sunday 22:00Z futures reopen, 22 hours beyond the final slot published here. Tail remains far below the block threshold in every slot.
headline: Weekend halt holds Tail at its floor while a 4.998% 10-year, 100-dollar crude and a 14.81 VIX wait for Sunday's reopen
body: The Nasdaq-100 cash index closed Friday at 29,644.17, up 197.17 points or 0.67%, finishing near the top of a 29,371.89-29,647.80 range. The E-mini NQ contract settled at 29,955.00, up 0.71%, having ranged 29,648.00-29,993.25. VIX eased 4.08% to 14.81 and closed at its session low, an unusually subdued mark against the current macro backdrop. The broad tape was mixed: the S&P 500 rose 0.17% to 7,650.50 while the Dow slipped 0.18% to 51,682.64 and lost 1.86% on the week, against a roughly 0.23% weekly gain for the Nasdaq. Friday also cleared about 7 trillion dollars of options notional in the second-largest triple witching on record, a positioning reset that is a conditional sensitivity for the new week rather than an observed condition now. Internals were rotational rather than one-way: semiconductor equipment rose 4.85% and semiconductors 1.87% while both software groups fell about 1%, and megacaps finished split four to four with AVGO up 2.97% against META down 2.43% and QCOM down 5.82%. The rates backdrop is the dominant carried driver. The FOMC raised its target range 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on 16 September in a unanimous 12-0 vote, its first increase since 2023, with 16 of 18 participants projecting another hike this year; the 10-year settled 4.998% after tagging 5.008% and the 2-year ended the week near 4.739%. WTI settled 100.30 dollars, down 1.58% and a third consecutive decline, with Brent at 103.87, as Saudi work to restore East-West pipeline capacity eased supply fears; Bab el-Mandeb has been under Houthi control since mid-September, and no new escalation has been verified since Friday's settlement. Survey positioning entered the break defensive, with AAII bearishness near 53% and Michigan year-ahead inflation expectations up to 4.6% from 4.0%. None of this can transmit to either instrument inside the halt: the entire 24-hour window runs from 01:00Z Saturday to 00:00Z Sunday, and futures do not reopen until 22:00Z on Sunday. Tail is therefore held between 5 and 7 across all slots, Stress decays into the low band through Saturday before edging back to 25, confidence declines only as a function of evidence age, dominant mode is normal throughout and no danger window is published.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding hourly assessments were published and every one stayed green. Tail held a 5-19 band and Stress ran between 26 and 51, peaking near 51 through the European morning and the U.S. afternoon before falling away to 33, 28, 27 and 26 in the final four hours as cash trading ended and the contract settled. Confidence sat between 84 and 88 throughout. Dominant mode rotated from normal across the Asian and early European hours to trend-up into the U.S. pre-open, to mixed through the cash session as leadership narrowed, briefly back to trend-up into the close, then to normal once the expiry cleared and venues shut.
outlookSummary: The entire 24-hour window falls inside the weekend halt: cash closed at 20:00Z, the E-mini settled at 21:00Z, and futures do not reopen until 22:00Z on Sunday, 22 hours after the final slot published here. Tail is held between 5 and 7 across all slots, with a marginal lift through Saturday that reflects the growing stock of unpriced weekend information rather than any observed structure. Stress decays from 25 into the low band, troughs at 20 around midday and edges back to 25 as the new week's agenda approaches. Confidence stays high and drifts from 83 to 76 purely as a function of evidence age. Dominant mode is normal in every slot and no danger window is published, because a pathological price path cannot form while no venue quotes.
